title: Single step site-selective reaction to construct a Ag2Au2 ← Ag4 supramolecular assembly from hybrid N-heterocyclic carbene (NHC): synthesis, structures and optoelectronic properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,13086-13094
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00684H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pooja Das, Soumi Halder, Partha Pratim Ray, Narayan Ch. Jana, Priyanka Sahu, Anvarhusein A. Isab, Rambabu Dandela, Ramalingam Natarajan, Joydev Dinda
A novel site-selective transmetallation strategy was developed to convert a Ag4 metallosupramolecular assembly into an NHC-stabilized Ag2Au2 heterometallic complex. The optoelectronic properties of the resulting complexes were explored.
